text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last, the day of the New Zealand Trophy
has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An important battle is about to begin that will predict
whether she can contend on the mile front in the future—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
“New Zealand Trophy”...
A mile graded stakes race...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The path of chasing the "Emperor of the Mile's"
back begins in earnest from here, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
—This path is the path that leads to the true wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Thinking about how I can keep drawing closer to the wind feels just like the refreshing breeze of early summer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Let us summon the spring easterly wind,
and carve open a brand-new path."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I shall be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: “—Now, the runners are making their way into the paddock one after another!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best!
I came here today to watch you win!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: I believe in you! Win this for sure, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (...What could it be?)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(My ears feel... unusually unsettled.
They're buzzing... tingling.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (A dry wind? A gentle breeze? ...Well, it's not an unpleasant feeling, though.)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah... You're Yamanin Zephyr-san, right?

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to today.
...I'm definitely not gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah, umm... yes.
It's a pleasure to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —I won't lose either.
